meta.title: Stock Market ML Trading System: ETF Signals and Backtesting

costs.charged_on: entry AND exit of every position, benchmark included

conventions.position_limit: one ETF per session, long only, max 100% of equity

data_sources.macro: FRED key-free CSV (VIXCLS, DGS10, DGS3MO) with CBOE/Treasury fallbacks
data_sources.factors: Kenneth R. French Data Library (5 factors + momentum)

sources.factors: Kenneth R. French Data Library (5 factors + momentum, daily)

notes: Raw datasets are git-ignored and reproduced by re-downloading.

strategy_descriptions.S1_top_probability: Buy the highest-probability ETF each session when its probability is above the validation-selected threshold; exit at the close.
strategy_descriptions.S2_conservative: Conservative variant: threshold +0.05 and only when the previous VIX is <= 25 (calm-regime filter).
strategy_descriptions.S3_trend_filter: Market-condition strategy: trade only when SPY closed above its 50-day moving average, with a +0.02 threshold buffer.
strategy_descriptions.S4_risk_managed: Risk-managed variant: position size scaled by the probability edge (25%-100% of capital) and a 1% intraday stop loss.

benchmarks.benchmark_notes: SPY open-to-close uses the exact same sessions and per-side costs as the strategies (like-for-like). Buy & hold is close-to-close with a single round-trip cost and a DIFFERENT holding period; it is context only.

latest_signal.execution: next session OPEN -> next session CLOSE (simulated only)
latest_signal.note: SIMULATION ONLY. The model was refit on all labelled data after the test evaluation; no order is sent anywhere.
